name: dotfiles
description: Work in the bare-repo dotfiles setup — status, committing config changes, the staging worktree, converging machine branches, drift since last convergence. Use when the user wants to check dotfiles status, add or commit config changes, reconcile/converge dotfiles, or mentions "$DOTFILES", "config repo", "dotfiles", or asks to add changes under ~/.config, ~/.local, etc. into their dotfiles or config.
